settings.title: Performance Mod v401
settings.description: Massive performance optimization for Stonehearth + ACE. v401 fixes critical hauling/build-pause/workshop bugs while preserving the perf gains. Native multiplayer support. Single-file inline architecture, hearthling-idle watchdog, circuit breaker.
settings.profile_description: Aggressiveness level. Balanced is recommended for most colonies. All profiles in v401 use the surgical PE coalesce and the P3-driven PA invalidation chain.

profiles.safe_description: Conservative settings. Larger entity spread limit. Watchdog trip target when idle issues detected.
profiles.balanced_description: Moderate optimization. Good for most colonies 15-20 hearthlings.
profiles.aggressive_description: Maximum optimization. For large towns 25+ hearthlings.

settings.instrumentation_description: Publishes performance counters to the profiler and log every 10s. Recommended on for troubleshooting.
